stops.title: Your settings
stops.caption: Account, security, appearance.
stops.speech: Settings covers your account, your sign-in methods, how Kairos looks, and which language it speaks to you in.

stops.title: Notifications
stops.caption: What reaches you, and how often.
stops.speech: Notifications are per category. Choose immediate or a daily digest for each, or turn one off entirely. Security alerts always arrive.
